record.question:
Reality shows revolve around two common factors: fame and money. We get to see participants on
    such shows from all walks of life including singers, sports persons, entrepreneurs, writers, social
    media personalities and vloggers to name a few being transformed on the platform. Some participants
    manage to capitalize their few hours of exposure on the show to forge their status as celebrities.
    Some participants also gain huge financial rewards for acts including eating foods which many would
    consider weird and revolting, displaying of uncontrolled emotions, marrying total strangers, and revealing
    their personal thoughts and opinions before thousands of viewers.
    The given paragraph best supports the statement that
options: The participants of Reality shows are interested in being rich and famous.
Reality show is the best thing that has happened to network television in a long time.
For Reality shows stars, fame will last only for few hours of exposure.
Reality shows represent a new wave of sensationalistic, low quality programming.
